title: Sea turtles
text:
Most sea turtles live in warm seas. Some swim near the beaches of Indonesia.

A sea turtle has a hard shell on its back. It has flippers instead of feet, so it is a strong swimmer. Sea turtles breathe air, so they swim up to the top of the water to take a breath.

A mother turtle usually comes to a beach at night. She digs a hole in the sand with her back flippers and lays her eggs. Then she covers them with sand and goes back to the sea.

After about two months, the baby turtles hatch. They dig their way out of the sand and hurry to the sea.

Some people help sea turtles by keeping beaches clean and safe.
